question: ______ is the first Indian woman to have won a Grammy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Tanvi Shah**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Tanvi Shah is the first Indian woman to win a Grammy Award.
 
• She received the award in 2010 for her contribution to the song Jai Ho from the movie Slumdog Millionaire.
 
• The award was in the category of Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media.
 
• Tanvi Shah is known for her versatility and has sung in multiple languages, including Spanish, Arabic, and Portuguese.&l
